description: Defines an abstract Server class and three concrete server implementations (TcpServer, VsockServer, DupServer) for socket proxying in the Android Open Source Project, including method declarations and class structures.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Abstract base class for different server types with virtual methods for starting the server and describing it.

classes.name: TcpServer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Server for TCP socket connections, with configurable port, retries, and delay.

classes.name: VsockServer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Server for Vsock connections, with configurable port and optional CID.

classes.name: DupServer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Server that duplicates an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the server, returning a Result containing a SharedFD.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the server instance.
